architecture.WOFOST_specific_composition_owner: new runtime/process-composition module outside crop kernel and outside generic F-MR runtime

source_bound_payload.potential_transpiration: canonical crop_root_uptake_input_t.potential_transpiration supplied for the same sparse WOFOST column and interval
source_bound_payload.actual_root_uptake_rate: sum of the exact fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t.root_extraction_sink vector passed to the serialized Richards trial
source_bound_payload.rate_integration: constant outer-interval rates integrated over [t0,t1]; current serialized physical forcing is fixed for that outer interval

precommit_sequence: validate sparse WOFOST column ids and state/parameter/forcing handles
validate canonical crop-root input and finite nonnegative PTRA
validate exact physical root_extraction_sink is present, finite and nonnegative and its sum is finite
capture pre-physical F-KT checkpoint provenance for each sparse WOFOST column
build complete F-WOF34 trial-local contribution scratch for [t0,t1]
prevalidate trial/window lineage, revision and interval contiguity without mutating the accepted window
only then call the existing serialized MultiSWAP runtime requesting sparse F-MR18 receipts
postcommit_sequence: non-ready receipt means zero WOFOST contribution and trial scratch discard
ready receipt must exactly match the prevalidated checkpoint/trial lineage, origin revision, committed revision and interval
derive the existing F-WOF34 F-KT accepted-interval certificate from the pre-captured checkpoint and committed post-state
admit the already-prevalidated trial to the accepted window exactly once
any impossible receipt/certificate/window mismatch is an invariant failure, not a normal recoverable postcommit status
qualification_obligations: exact applied root sink sum identity
mass accounting bitwise or exact semantic identity
F-WOF34 exact transcript preservation or explicitly reconciled additive API extension
